subject: Activation collision-avoidance: network quarantine window + smoke playbook
body:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: alyssa.mendoza@acme-corp.com, procure@acme-corp.com
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Activation collision-avoidance: network quarantine window + smoke playbook

Team —

We have the final go-live window for Acme Financial next week (5/28). Two asks before I greenlight the activation:

1) Collision avoidance: Acme has multiple teams migrating services into the same VPC segments during the window. We need a temporary L2/L3 quarantine plan so we don’t accidentally overlap IP allocations or route injections. Karthik, can you propose the minimal ACL set and a single write-down sequencing order?

2) Smoke playbook coupling: We need an explicit, short smoke checklist that the on-call SRE can run within 5–10 minutes per availability zone: (a) control-plane handshake, (b) KV cache warm start validation, (c) L7 health + sample inference, (d) fallback verification to hosted route. Mina — I attached a first-pass KV primer (kvcache-primer-v1.pdf). Please fold into the runbook.

3) Procurement / maintenance window: Procurement asked for an exact maintenance window to update their DocuSign. I’ve CC’d ProcureOps. We cannot do a rolling activation outside the agreed window without signoff.

Can we do a dry-run rehearsal Monday 5/24 @ 10:30am PT? If yes, I’ll schedule the bridge.

Thanks — rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Director, Ops
Redwood Inference

----
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, mina_haddad@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Activation collision-avoidance: network quarantine window + smoke playbook

+1 on the rehearsal. For collision avoidance:
- I propose a two-phase quarantine: 'pre-commit' (deny-all except management CIDRs and control-plane) and 'commit' (open specific subnets per team in a strict sequence). That will let us verify connectivity for each team in isolation.
- Karthik, we need an explicit ordering file: subnet -> responsible contact -> time slot. If we can lock the first three subnets for the rehearsal, we can walk through the ordering.

Mina, for KV cache primer: can you add a small validation harness that does a warm-start and asserts cache hit-rate > 75% in 30s? If it fails, we auto-disable cache and mark a ticket.

I’ll set up a short ops checklist doc and link it to the bridge invite.

Laura
Engineering Manager, Network Ops

----
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, mina_haddad@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Activation collision-avoidance: network quarantine window + smoke playbook

Agree with the two-phase approach. Draft sequencing (short):
1) Reserve management CIDR & control-plane endpoints (10:100.0.0/24) — 10:30-10:40
2) Team A subnet (10:101.1.0/24) — 10:40-10:50
3) Team B subnet (10:101.2.0/24) — 10:50-11:00
4) Border routing sanity & BGP session validation — 11:00-11:10

I uploaded a quick ordering spreadsheet (segment-deploy-plan.xlsx) with contact columns. I’ll be on the rehearsal bridge to run the ACL push and monitor route updates.

Karthik
Senior Network Engineer

----
From: Alyssa Mendoza <alyssa.mendoza@acme-corp.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, procure@acme-corp.com
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Activation collision-avoidance: network quarantine window + smoke playbook

Thanks Rishi — Acme confirms 5/28 maintenance window 02:00–05:00 PT. ProcureOps will send final DocuSign by EOD Monday once you confirm the exact start time.

For the rehearsal on Monday 5/24 @ 10:30am PT, Alyssa (NetEng) and our ops SRE (sre-oncall@edgecloud.com) will join. We request that the rehearsal include a simulated failure step where KV cache warmup fails and we verify the automatic fallback to hosted route. That is a gating requirement for our Risk team.

Alyssa
NetEng, Acme Financial

----
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 15:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Activation collision-avoidance: network quarantine window + smoke playbook

Thanks — attached is the isolation-runbook.md (short), and kvcache-primer-v1.pdf. Notes:
- I added a 30s warm-start harness that returns a small JSON with hitRate and latency. If hitRate < 75% we mark 'KV_FAILED' and trigger the fallback hook to the hosted inference route (see runbook step 5).
- For the rehearsal I can toggle the cache flag remotely to force a failure so Acme can watch the fallback.
- I trimmed the smoke checklist to 6 steps so it fits in the bridge readout (control-plane, mgmt CIDR, subnet probe, kv-warm, sample inference, fallback check).

Attachments: isolation-runbook.md, kvcache-primer-v1.pdf

Mina
Principal Reliability Engineer

----
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: alyssa.mendoza@acme-corp.com, procure@acme-corp.com, sre-oncall@edgecloud.com
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Activation collision-avoidance: network quarantine window + smoke playbook

Perfect — thanks everyone. Action items before Monday rehearsal: 
- Karthik: finalize subnet ordering spreadsheet and add contact phone numbers (due Mon 5/24 09:00 PT).
- Mina: attach the small harness to the runbook and make the failure toggle visible in the bridge UI.
- Laura/Marissa: create the short bridge checklist and post the invite for 10:30 PT; include the Acme and EdgeCloud contacts.
- ProcureOps/Alyssa: confirm DocuSign start time once we post the bridge invite.

If everyone is aligned I’ll open the bridge invite and mark the rehearsal as mandatory for on-call.

Rishi
